description: Ministry of Water Supply - Amend to the Extra Gazette No. 2196/37 ot 07.10.2020, Counteractions of Water Treatment Plant Under Mahaoya, Gampola Yayamalpura Water Supply Projects and Errata Notice to the Extra Gazette No. 2218/63 of 10.03.2021
reasoning: The gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains three separate orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, all approving the acquisition of specific land parcels for water supply projects. Each order includes detailed descriptions of the land properties, including location, boundaries, extent (in perches), and the names of claimants. While a government minister is named, the core content focuses on land acquisition rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
